spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, y dirás a ellos: Cuando entren a la tierra que yo dando a ustedes, y sieguen su cosecha, y traerán ómer de principio de cosecha de ustedes al sacerdote.

findings.issue: Common noun עֹמֶר is left as the transliteration ómer; a non-name lemma stays Spanish.

Qal imperfect 2mp and the following qal sequential perfect 2mp are both subjunctive under Cuando; mood is Spanish smoothing and the reap clause is no longer the same sequential perfect force as traerán.
Suffix is 3fs (the land’s harvest). su also fits ustedes and can be read as the addressees’ harvest.

notes: Other tokens match person, number, stem, and construct order; ustedes forms are licensed 2pl.
